story_type: capsized boat far offshore, four men in the water, basket hoists
hook: Their boat flipped thirty miles out. Four men in the water.
narration: Their boat flipped thirty miles off Florida, and all four men ended up in the water.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Clearwater found them in the open Gulf.
The rescue swimmer rode the cable down into the rotor wash.
A basket is used because a worn out swimmer only has to roll in and hold on.
One by one, the hoist pulled them up to the door.
Then the basket went straight back down for the next man.
outcome: All four men were hoisted from the water and taken to land with no injuries reported.
title: Boat flipped 30 miles out, 4 in the water
description:
Four men ended up in the water after their boat capsized 30 miles west of Cedar Key, Florida, on June 25, 2021. A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew hoisted all four and took them to land.
